user.title: Export a Home Assistant camera
user.description: Create one authenticated virtual ONVIF/RTSP camera. Only the listed IP addresses may connect. This integration does not control physical doors. Configure the same dedicated credentials in the recorder.

data.name: Virtual camera name
data.window_seconds: Video window after the latest activation (seconds)
data.bind_ip: Local IPv4 address to listen on
data.allowed_clients: Allowed client IPv4 addresses, one per line
data.event_at_field: UTC timestamp field in event data
data.binary_sensor: Binary sensor that activates on an on transition

data_description.camera_entity: Select the existing camera integration; no native camera credentials are needed.
data_description.bind_ip: An exact address assigned to this Home Assistant host. Wildcard listeners are not accepted.
data_description.onvif_port: 1986 is the staging default. An occupied port cannot be used.
data_description.rtsp_port: 18557 is the staging default. A different port from ONVIF is required.
data_description.password: Use a separate printable ASCII password, 16–128 characters. Do not reuse the Home Assistant or camera password.
data_description.allowed_clients: Exact IPv4 hosts only; no subnet, CIDR, wildcard or anonymous access.
data_description.trigger_mode: Manual always provides an Activate button. Event and binary-sensor modes also activate automatically.
data_description.event_filter: Flat fields are combined with AND. A list of permitted values for one field means OR. For BTicino, enter its entry_id and permitted event_key values explicitly.
data_description.event_at_field: Events must be current; the runtime rejects old timestamps and duplicate activations.
data_description.binary_sensor: Used only in Binary sensor mode. A restored or unavailable state is not an activation.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the virtual camera
reconfigure.description: All changes apply to this exporter only. The virtual device identity stays fixed. Leave the password blank to keep it. If ports or credentials change, update the recorder settings.

data.name: Virtual camera name
data.window_seconds: Video window after the latest activation (seconds)
data.bind_ip: Local IPv4 address to listen on
data.password: New dedicated password (blank keeps the current password)
data.allowed_clients: Allowed client IPv4 addresses, one per line
data.event_at_field: UTC timestamp field in event data
data.binary_sensor: Binary sensor that activates on an on transition
